review.posthog_relevance: Adds Google Calendar as a supported integration kind, including OAuth configuration and frontend selection options.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates the addition of Google Calendar support across database models, OAuth configuration, frontend selection, and documentation. While the chunk lacks the complete implementation of the calendar sync and meeting API, it establishes the foundational support and configuration. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
